sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Sigrika is a 5-star Aero Gauntlets DPS character who specializes in the Echo Skill damage archetype, similar to characters like Phrolova and Galbrena. Much like Galbrena, she gets up close and personal to deal high-damaging Aero blows to enemies; but unlike her, Sigrika doesn't focus on entering an enhanced state to deal her damage; instead, she builds up to a Forte Skill in order to blow enemies away. Let's look into how to do exactly that:

sections.heading: Key Mechanics
paragraphs: Sigrika's kit focuses on generating and consuming Runes via Heavy Attacks in order to cast her Forte Skill. She does this via her Basic Attacks, Intro, and Ultimate, all of which are related to Rune generation. Essentially, Sigrika can generate one Rune after performing a full Basic Attack chain. However, this can be upgraded to 2 Runes per chain if she has cast her Intro or Ultimate within the past 20 seconds. One of these Heavy Attacks will be using 2 of the same runes and the other will be using 2 different rune types. Each rune type influences what Heavy Attack is performed. This is similar to Phrolova's Forte Basics and Forte Skills.

Sigrika's Runes gained via her enhanced Basic Attack (which is indicated by the glow on the Basic Attack button after a full Basic Chain) will generate Runes used to stagnate enemies, while Runes gained via her enhanced Skill (indicated by the glow on the Skill button in a similar fashion) will generate Runes used to group enemies.

Sigrika's special Heavy Attacks can be used if she has any two or more Runes. If two Runes of the same type are present (this will be the case after her Intro), then the actual effect, depending on the Rune type selected, will take place. However, due to the nature of her Ultimate generating two opposite-type Runes, the next Heavy Attack will simply deal higher damage while having no extra effects instead.
Finally, once both Heavy Attacks were used, holding her Skill button will cast her big Forte Skill nuke, ending her rotation.

sections.heading: Practical Gameplay & Related Mechanics
paragraphs: Given her Key Mechanics explained above, we can come up with a simple rotation where Sigrika casts a full Basic Attack chain after Intro, casts a Heavy Attack, casts her Ultimate, redoes a full Basic Attack chain into a Heavy, and then she's ready to use her Forte Skill and Outro. Very easy to understand and execute. However, Sigrika has other mechanics that are important to keep in mind when playing her in practice.

First of all, if she needs to dodge out of the way of enemies, it's not a problem. Her dodge counter works so that the next attack that comes after it is a Basic Attack 4, which means she can easily generate Runes quickly after dodging an enemy attack to ensure a smooth rotation.

Secondly, it's worth noting Sigrika has mechanics that discourage swapping, since she'd not only lose out on team Outro Buffs, but also her own Aero and Echo skill damage buff only applies to the active character on-field (this is given via her Inherent Skills and depends on the amount of Echo Skill casts in the team), and she will also lose out on a significant amount of DMG Amplification built into her Forte on all of her most damaging abilities.

Thirdly and finally, Sigrika can Stagnate enemies when other characters cast their own Echo Skills after her Outro. This helps inconsistent characters like Qiuyuan, and makes them able to consistently execute scripted rotations against aggressive bosses without as much issue (although the impact is small overall, since her Supports tend to run 5P Moonlit Clouds with very few edge cases anyway so they can't use the Echo Skill until right before their rotation is finished).

sections.heading: Meta Position & Conclusion
paragraphs: Sigrika is a strong DPS, but this comes at a cost. Almost all of her damage is Echo Skill DMG, which basically no character can buff aside from Qiuyuan or Lucilla. To make matters worse, Sigrika has 3 different layers of built-in mechanics that depend on the amount of Echo Skills cast in the team, built into her Forte and Inherent Skills. They each give significant amounts of DMG Bonus and DMG Amplification on her highest-damaging abilities. This makes her performance very reliant on Qiuyuan or Lucilla, as her strongest alternatives come in the form of characters like Lynae and Mornye who really pale in comparison.

Overall, Sigrika's reliance on Qiuyuan or Lucilla as teammates is very much felt, and she is stranded for other teammate options currently due to the amount of mechanics she has that are tied to having a higher amount of Echo Skill casts than normal in the team, as well as her more exclusive damage type which has no viable permanently accessible options. While she definitely has strong potential, her opportunity cost should definitely be kept in mind, especially considering she also lacks strong F2P weapon alternatives unlike her predecessors Luuk Herssen and Aemeath.

In conclusion, while Sigrika is a super strong DPS, she has a major flaw in regards to opportunity cost, which makes her pull value worth questioning depending on your account. But if you give Sigrika the conditions she needs to shine, she'll absolutely serve you as one of the strongest DPS in the game. Her modern damage numbers are nothing to scoff at, as she is easily one of the strongest WhiWa DPS thanks to her ridiculous AoE and fast rotation. Plus, she is one of the strongest in ToA/Matrix too,  all this so long as she is provided with the sufficient amount of investment and surrounded by the proper teammates.

synergies.commentary: These are the best buffers Sigrika has to increase her damage. Qiuyuan and Lucilla provide the Echo Skill casts and Echo Skill damage buffs Sigrika desires to take full leverage of her kit, making them the strongest synergies by a lot and a staple of all top Sigrika teams. Ciaccona is the best third slot buffer with Qiuyuan thanks to her ability to buff party-wide Aero DMG and provide Aero RES Shred with her Signature, though without her Signature Shorekeeper, particularly with Lucilla, will be privileged. She can also work in the second slot alongside Shorekeeper or Aero Rover. Finally, Lynae is the alternative if you lack the other options thanks to her very generalized buffing capabilities.

Phrolova has a particular synergy with Sigrika, since they function in a very similar way and can both take advantage of Qiuyuan's extra Echo Skill casts at the same time to deal lots of damage together. Sigrika has the ability to buff Phrolova a little bit with her Inherent Skill but it doesn't amount to much, it's mostly just the two working well with Qiuyuan to deal high damage in tandem. Works fantastically well for Whimpering Wastes and can be considered for single-target encounters if Phrolova lacks her ideal teammates like Cantarella.

Some of the best third slot teammates for Sigrika are listed here. Shorekeeper is generally the strongest choice in a lot of cases thanks to her extra Sustain capabilities compared to Ciaccona and also the fact she doesn't need a Signature weapon to provide close to the fullest extent of her team buffs. Mornye works better than her in tandem with Lynae, Aero Rover works better in tandem with Ciaccona if you use alternative teams to Sigrika's best. Finally, if none of those options are preferred, Verina works generally well as a permanently accessible and very capable Support.
